current_training_effect: none; v14 worker, source, contracts and GPU execution are unchanged by these documents

inspected_sources.note: Helper SHAs describe locally inspected code, not a newly deployed probe revision. A future implementation must freeze its own source and receipt.

proposed_entrypoint.name: scripts/probe_recovery_physical_prefix.py
proposed_entrypoint.required_input: --contract contracts/v6_task_campaign_recovery_worker_v8.json plus full PT and output directory
proposed_entrypoint.source_rule: Load/authenticate the explicit V8 worker and its independent V8 expectations. Do not call the old 1 kHz recovery plan materializer to choose source semantics.
proposed_entrypoint.engineering_projection: First verify the unchanged full role; independently project the same four cases and coverage lists/scenes in runtime and authenticated expectations; freeze a new engineering role invocation with the selected count and seed. Allowed projection changes are case/coverage selection, scene selection/fractions, repeats and invocation count only. Physics, FSM, source case content, thresholds and module enablement remain unchanged.
proposed_entrypoint.forbidden_shortcut: Do not pass --num-envs 4 to probe_recovery_takeover unchanged train-role validation; do not use the old 20000/20-substep capacity path.

reusable_helpers.limits: Adapt the pattern to explicit V8 contract input; old default plan/materialize and 1 kHz capacity branch are not valid new entrypoints.

helpers: checkpoint provenance and ABI checks from authenticate
reusable_helpers.limits: The current authenticate requires unchanged train role and count; Recorder reset_rows assumes train curriculum bank geometry. Neither is directly suitable for fixed four-case full-role projection.
Birth transaction includes parent and subclass state writes plus frozen 0–2 mm recovery root-z jitter.
Observe native outputs only. Do not replace FSM/control, inject contact truth into FSM or force phase transitions.

cohort.episode_policy: first episode only; cohort identity and denominator are immutable; autoreset episodes do not enter counts
cohort.primary_denominator: seeded_cohort_N, fixed at successful initialization before physical stepping
cohort.initialization_failure: invalid_probe, not a silent reduction of N
cohort.partition_rule: Mutually exclusive final attribution by a frozen precedence rule; raw termination-reason flags may overlap and must also be retained. Final partition counts sum to N.
cohort.secondary_conditional_ratios: success/ended and success/handed_over may be shown with explicit numerators/denominators, never labelled full-chain completion

physical_continuity.initialization_transaction: Open only around environment creation and selected reset_suite birth. Permit native parent/subclass writes; record them, verify the selected profile and frozen seeded jitter, then close before first active cohort physics step.
physical_continuity.violation: Any selected live cohort state write after birth invalidates its physical-prefix evidence; report probe invalid rather than repairing/resetting the lane. Terminal autoreset writes are allowed only after old-cohort terminal evidence is captured and its cohort closed.
physical_continuity.native_chain: One birth geometry injection -> 1 s zero active motor effort with gravity/gas springs/contact -> native sensor FSM and PD torques -> actual 200 ms torque BLEND -> pure RL hold -> motion unlock -> followup.
physical_continuity.fsm_counter_reset_at_release: Existing FSM/encoder activation reset is not a physics-state reset; retain actual physical state and actuator/delay history and record this event.
forbidden: forcing a failed route into BLEND
claiming geometry_valid or V5 success as V6 dynamic qualification
physical_continuity.initial_state_check: q18 matches named bank order; root includes lane origin and FixedCaseEnv frozen seeded 0–2 mm z jitter; velocity readback and joint units are explicit; finite/closure checks are recorded.

events.name: birth_complete
events.capture: after all birth writes, before first physical step

events.name: passive_release_finished
events.capture: before and after native controller activation on actual settled state

events.name: fsm_phase_transition
events.capture: each actual phase/route/reroute transition with pre/post masks and targets

events.name: blend_entry_pre_effort
events.capture: actual PREPARE->BLEND reference update, after update and before torque application

events.name: blend_first_applied_post_physics
events.capture: first mixed/script-weighted torque passes transport/response then physics updates

events.name: blend_last_mixed_post_physics
events.capture: last physical substep whose applied control fraction is less than one

events.name: first_pure_rl_post_physics
events.capture: first fraction-one physical substep after native BLEND completion

events.name: sensor_hold_dwell_complete
events.capture: native consecutive sensor hold threshold reached

events.name: truth_hold_dwell_complete
events.capture: native outcome consecutive physical truth hold threshold reached

events.name: motion_unlock
events.capture: first unlock before/after native outcome; preserve hold evidence from the just-ended interval

events.name: terminal_pre_autoreset
events.capture: before parent reset overwrites root/q/history; keep terminal reason and actor ownership

recording.event_snapshots: all requested tensors/states cloned at event time, bounded selected cohort only; persist after collection rather than adding unrestricted hot-path print/log loops
recording.missing_blend_snapshot: never_reached_blend with preceding failure/timeout evidence; do not synthesize it

joint_coordinates.note: Do not label the entire 18-DOF vector radians: the two spring slides are prismatic.

snapshot_limits.reason: q/root/control histories do not serialize all PhysX contact, constraint/solver and warm-start hidden state.
snapshot_limits.comparison_rule: Use uninterrupted same-environment same-prefix execution as the reference. Snapshots are diagnostic/event artifacts; future exact-resume or exported-dynamic-state sampling requires independent validation.
snapshot_limits.rng_note: Capture relevant generators and document scope; selected-lane tensor state plus shared whole-batch RNG is not a claim that an arbitrary reduced scene replays bitwise.

gate_audit.route_and_script: Record every actual SELECT/FOLD/PLANT/ORBIT/THRUST/SIDE/CAPTURE/PREPARE transition, its remaining/error/contact observer conditions, dwell, timeout and reroute; count reached routes, do not require a route the native dispatcher did not select.
gate_audit.prepare: All eight FSM stable masks plus target remaining/error; native ready_ticks must cover consecutive 0.1 s.
gate_audit.blend: Actual 40 reference ticks/200 ms mix and ownership for each physical substep; not phase-ever alone.
gate_audit.rl_hold_sensor: Eight masks conjunction continuously for native 1 s; independent mask hit rates do not count as joint success.
gate_audit.rl_hold_truth: Native true contact/undesired contact/platform/tilt/omega/height/speed hold; capture native consecutive 1 s and failures before unlock.
gate_audit.unlock: Report sensor unlock, truth-qualified-before-unlock and premature-release separately; do not feed truth back into deployed observer.
gate_audit.followup: Existing native continuous 1 s followup condition; stand planar speed, velocity/yaw errors and actual stability recorded with thresholds from the frozen source.
gate_audit.primary_tables: Per case and all fixed cohort: reached count/N, first event time, first failure phase, final partition.
gate_audit.secondary_tables: Per entered-stage denominator explicitly shown; tick pass/conjunction/dwell/min-margin/first-blocker distributions separately labelled.
gate_audit.reward_and_learning: Record native masks/costs/payment and interval ownership; no learn/update/compute_returns/rollout storage.

module_enablement.usb_enabled: Read and record actual frozen effective config/startup; do not infer from command_transport.
module_enablement.claims: First role does not validate training frame-delay randomization, even though it captures absent/disabled delay history state.

future_delay_role.requires: New independently frozen engineering role explicitly enabling the chosen physical signal-delay profile/schedule and exact matching initial/RNG/history semantics. Preserve 200/50 Hz, asset/ABI/FSM and original thresholds. Run as separately labelled condition.
future_delay_role.forbidden: Hot enabling signal_delay while presenting the unchanged full-role identity or qualification.

implementation_validation_required: independent design projection mismatch rejects startup
fixed cohort partition and denominators checked
joint unit/order and finite arrays checked
substep mix/200 ms and full history retention checked
signal_delay actual status matches frozen role
